tools.name: ipo-lookup
tools.description: Takes an IPO name fragment and returns up to 25 matching Indian mainboard and SME IPOs with dates, price band, lot size, registrar and status URL, and listing-day gain. Pure lookup, no network calls. Example input: {"query":"jio"}

tools.name: ipo-calendar
tools.description: Takes a phase and returns up to 50 Indian IPOs in it (default allotment-this-week): upcoming, open, closed, allotted, listed, or allotment-this-week (default, allotment dates from 2 days ago to 7 days ahead). Up to 50 rows, newest first, with dates, price, lot size and the page that checks allotment

tools.name: ipo-details
tools.description: Takes an IPO slug or name fragment and returns the full public details of that Indian IPO: dates, price band, lot size, registrar and status URL, phase and listing-day gains. Example input: {"ipo":"jio"}

tools.name: listing-gains
tools.description: Takes an optional board and row limit and returns listing-day gains of listed Indian IPOs against the issue price, at open and at close, newest listing first. Example input: {"board":"all","limit":20}

tools.name: check-allotment
tools.description: Takes an IPO and a PAN and returns whether that PAN was allotted shares in the Indian IPO (allotted, not allotted or no record), from the registrar's official records. PAN is used once for the lookup and never stored. Example input: {"ipo":"jio","pan":"ABCDE1234F"}
